correctness.rationale: The moment equations constrain positive weights to p in [1/4,3/4] and force the stage nodes; M_11>=0 gives a_12<=-f(p). A strict derivative sign change proves the unique minimizer of f. The constructed A_p has M=0 and satisfies the fourth order-three condition by A^T b=b-Bc; its only negative coefficient equals -f(p). Equality and PSD force uniqueness. The standalone checker replayed successfully with 3064 rational/numerical supplementary assertions; the analytic proof handles all admissible tableaux.

value.rationale: Third-order RK design balances norm-based B-stability from the algebraic stability matrix against positivity/SSP, whose positive radius requires nonnegative Butcher entries. The exact minimal unavoidable negativity within the natural two-stage interval-normalized class and its unique symplectic minimizer quantify that structural incompatibility, giving a nontrivial complete extremal classification rather than one arbitrary negative tableau. No downstream performance guarantee is claimed.
